component.name: Ebb
component.summary: Listen to TIDAL in lossless and hi-res

description.p: Ebb is a TIDAL player for Linux built for lossless and hi-res audio: bit-perfect and exclusive output paths, a parametric equalizer, synced lyrics and a real-time visualizer. A TIDAL subscription is required.
Ebb is based on hiresTI by yelanxin. It is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by TIDAL.
First release under the Ebb name, based on hiresTI 1.9.12.
